## Simulation

The governing equations of this chaotic system are

$$
\begin{eqnarray}
\dot{x} &=& z \\
\dot{y} &=& xy+xz \\
\dot{z} &=& ax^3+y^3
\end{eqnarray}
$$

with $a=-0.1$.
